scripts.dev:server: cross-env FM_SERVER_PORT=8787 cargo watch -w apps/fm-server -w crates -w Cargo.toml -w Cargo.lock -x 'run -p fm-server -- --dev-mode-auth-disabled'
scripts.dev:tauri: cd apps/fm-desktop/src-tauri && pnpm exec tauri dev
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:rust && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.api:check: pnpm run api:export && pnpm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code
scripts.build: pnpm run build:rust && pnpm run build:frontend
